questions.question: A 240 V heater draws 12 A. What is the power rating?
questions.explanation: Use (P = E × I). (240 × 12 = 2880W). The heater is rated 2880 watts.

questions.question: In a pure resistive AC circuit, voltage and current are:
questions.explanation: In a resistive circuit, current follows voltage directly. There is no inductive or capacitive phase shift. Power factor is 1 or unity.

questions.question: What does a diode do in a circuit?
questions.explanation: A diode is a semiconductor device. It conducts when forward biased. It blocks current when reverse biased.

questions.category: D1 — Interpret plans, drawings and specifications
questions.question: A drawing note says a receptacle is mounted 450 mm AFF. What does AFF mean?
questions.explanation: AFF means above finished floor. It is a mounting height reference. Measurements are taken from finished floor level.

questions.category: H1 — Install single-phase consumer/supply services and metering equipment
questions.question: In a 120/240 V single-phase service, line-to-neutral voltage is normally:
questions.explanation: Each ungrounded conductor to neutral gives 120 V. Line-to-line gives 240 V. This is common for residential services.
